section_summary.extract_value: The conclusion reports that the final model examining interpersonal and intrapersonal predictors of body appreciation and its link to intuitive eating fit well for a sample of college women; it identifies body appreciation as a central mediator between interpersonal/intrapersonal variables and intuitive eating. The section notes body appreciation did not predict unique variance in depressive symptoms and recommends testing similar models with diverse samples. The text refers to results from a single study (referred to as "this study").
section_summary.evidence_source: Our final model investigating interpersonal and intrapersonal links to body appreciation, as well as body appreciation's connection to intuitive eating, provided a good fit with college women. Given that research on positive body image is beginning to take hold, exploring models such as the one presented in this study with diverse samples may offer valuable information on the interpersonal and intrapersonal links to body appreciation among all individuals.
